work.description: The act treats Baden, a Paris pamphlet, Italy and the Far East missions. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX. — PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF131-135) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF8217-8217 reads: . HABATA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE XVII DECEMBRIS MDCCCLX. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
